verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions MCP. Its 'server' references are to the gz-sim simulation server and to socket-based Gazebo Transport messaging, which are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server. AI-readiness probes (llms.txt, OpenAPI) also return 404.
